rules.rationale: This is the base equation defining the #vowels mathematical summary on the empty string.
This recurrence defines #vowels for a nonempty string whose first character is an ordinary vowel, adding one and summarizing the tail.
This equation defines the terminal y/Y branch of #vowels, returning one when the sole remaining non-ordinary-vowel character is y or Y.
This fallback recurrence defines #vowels by summarizing the tail when the first character contributes no vowel count.
